groups.label: Obedience directed to God or a messenger

Obedience to an explicit command or order

items.dominant: Obedience directed to God or a messenger in 48 of 72 uses

outside.how: The speakers say others might have obeyed them, in a counterfactual about deaths.
Women are the ones who may obey the men addressed.
The object is Moses’s command.
The target is described as a human like the addressees.
The prohibition targets the order of transgressors.
The speakers say they obeyed their leaders and elders.
A ruler’s people are described as obeying him.
The speakers say they will obey their interlocutors in part of a matter.
The Messenger is described as one who might obey the audience.
The speakers promise not to obey anyone concerning the audience.
The conditional target is a group among the people given scripture.
The conditional target is most of the people on earth.
The conditional target is referred to as “them” after Satan’s allies are mentioned.
The prohibition targets one person described as heedless.
The prohibition targets the disbelievers.
The prohibition targets both parents.
The prohibition targets disbelievers and hypocrites.
The prohibition targets a person described as given to oaths.
The prohibition targets a sinner or an ungrateful person.
The prohibition targets one person directly.
